DashboardEvent.description:
One entry in the important-events strip -- a merged, time-ordered
projection of M1.139's `/news` and `/events` feeds (the same merge
the Flutter M1.140 UI already does client-side, done once here
server-side so the dashboard needs only one request).
DashboardEvent.title: DashboardEvent

DashboardOpportunity.description:
One top-opportunity summary card, per EPIC-M3.2's API Contract field
list. A deliberately leaner projection of M1.135's `RecommendationSummary`
-- only the fields the EPIC names, plus `id` -- not a second, divergent
recommendation representation (the underlying row is the exact same one
`/recommendations` returns). `id` is the one addition beyond the EPIC's
own "must expose at minimum" list: the Acceptance Criteria requires
"navigation into full opportunity/detail views", which is impossible
without an identifier for the existing `/recommendation/:id` detail
route -- an honest, necessary extension, not a contract violation
("at minimum" permits additional fields).
DashboardOpportunity.title: DashboardOpportunity

DashboardTrustSummary.description:
A compact projection of M1.147's `/tracking/summary` -- only the
fields relevant to a one-glance trust widget. Not a recomputation:
every value here is read verbatim from `TrackingSummary`.
DashboardTrustSummary.title: DashboardTrustSummary

DataFreshness.description:
Per-section as-of timestamps so a viewer can tell which parts of the
snapshot are current vs. stale, without fabricating a single combined
number across sources that update on different cadences.
DataFreshness.title: DataFreshness

DisplayPreferences.description:
Free-form key/value display settings (e.g. theme, density). No
domain module owns display concerns, so this is validated only as a
JSON object -- values are opaque to the API layer.
DisplayPreferences.title: DisplayPreferences

IndexQuote.description:
Shape reserved for future index-level data. Always empty for now --
this platform ingests individual NSE equity prices only, no index
(e.g. NIFTY50) feed exists, so fabricating a value here would be
dishonest rather than merely incomplete.
IndexQuote.title: IndexQuote

OpportunityFilters.description:
Echoes back exactly the filters/sort this response was computed
with (AC: filter combinations are server-side and deterministic --
a client should never have to guess what was actually applied).
OpportunityFilters.title: OpportunityFilters

PredictionVersions.description: Every version tag needed to replay how this recommendation was produced.
PredictionVersions.title: PredictionVersions

SessionRequest.description:
Only consulted when establishing a brand-new session (no valid
``Authorization`` bearer session token on the request) -- see
``api/services/auth.py``. ``userId`` is verified by whichever
``CredentialVerifier`` this deployment configures (see
``app.auth_session``); the default, until a real identity provider is
integrated, is self-asserted.
SessionRequest.title: SessionRequest
